headline: Exact authority, deliberate identity, living season chapters, and fail-closed evidence now form one coherent first-session-to-career architecture.

items.title: Exact dual-runtime API authority
items.evidence: 111 browser contracts plus 9 classified shared routes join exact 120-route local/server adapters; missing and unexpected routes both fail.

items.title: Agent-neutral current-intent routing
items.evidence: Latest intent/current work drive explainable mode evidence and Codex receives no incompatible model-family advice.

items.title: Exact delegated ContractService
items.evidence: Only getCapSummary remains public; a method-level manifest and reflection guard reject undelegated scaffold drift.

items.title: Deliberate Architect identity
items.evidence: Continuity and observed reinforce/counter adaptation replace raw tactic-variety points with a visible non-causal breakdown.

items.title: Living Season chapter
items.evidence: One versioned pure authority names the current chapter and next call from persisted season receipts across Week Room and Return Digest.

items.title: Playable first-session proof
items.evidence: Playwright completes onboarding, applied contract, weekly plan, ledger, mastery, and Season-horizon transition without an API shortcut.

items.title: Second-order authority saturation
items.evidence: Human-action parsing is singular, stale mutation/evidence scripts are retired, and the visual matrix self-validates 53 captures.

followUps.title: Fresh next arc
followUps.evidence: Primary and viable second-order queues are exhausted; begin a new live-code audit unless external release evidence changes.

blockers.title: Hosted release evidence family
blockers.evidence: Canonical /_health and edge headers, received email, approval, same-revision staging provenance, and registry reconciliation remain incomplete.

honestyLedger.title: Initial failures retained
honestyLedger.evidence: The unsharded test and 34px touch-target failures are diagnostic non-evidence, superseded only by complete direct reruns after root fixes.

honestyLedger.title: No causal mastery claim
honestyLedger.evidence: Identity output describes committed decisions and observed response only.

honestyLedger.title: No phantom launch
honestyLedger.evidence: Local and workflow success are not substituted for hosted identity, email, approval, or lifecycle evidence.

diffStat.suite: Node 489/489 · Playwright 19/19 · responsive 53 captures · Pages build/50-module reachability/smoke · implementation workflows 4/4 green · doctor blockingFailing 0
